messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up: product wants to push a tiered quota adjustment next week for hosted plans. Need comms & a small rollout plan. Who can help own customer-facing messaging?

Liam (AM): I can pull the top 25 accounts by 30d peak. Several will need heads-up 48h beforehand. Which segments are we targeting?

Aisha (CS): Target: all paid hosted: Starter (<100k tokens/day), Growth (100k-1M), Scale (>1M). Change = introduce soft-warning at 80% of limit + 24h auto-scaling opt-in. Rollout can be staged by segment.

Chen (Solutions): For Scale customers, recommend private outreach + dedicated CS touch. For Growth, just email + in-console banner. We should offer one free burst for first week.

Olivia (Ops): I'll add a per-account flag in the admin UI to exempt for 7 days. Need the exact field name from eng.

Kenji (Product): Field name will be `quota_exempt_until` (ISO8601). Also adding header X-Quota-Tier in response for monitoring. Landing change scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC.

Aisha (CS): Perfect — ops + eng, can you confirm timeline? We need comms 72/48/24h cadence for Growth and Scale.

Olivia (Ops): Timeline confirmed: admin flag + banner by Wed 18:00 UTC. API header change Thurs 02:00 UTC. I'll open infra ticket: INF-3421.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: feature/quota-exempt to prod on 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z (PR #6324). No downtime expected.

Liam (AM): For outreach, please share a short email we can customize. I'll own personalization for top 20.

Aisha (CS): Draft below — feedback welcome:

````
Subject: Important: Upcoming quota limits & temporary burst options

Hi {{first_name}},

On April 1 we are introducing tiered soft-limits to improve reliability. You'll see in-console notices when you're at 80% of your current quota.

What this means for you:
- Short-term burst: one free burst for 24h if you opt-in during the first week.
- Auto-scaling opt-in to reduce throttling risk.
- Contact your AM to request a temporary exemption.

Action required: no immediate action unless you expect >80% usage this week. Reply to this email or DM your AM.

Thanks,
Aisha, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
````

Chen (Solutions): Suggest adding "How we calculate quota" link to KB and an example of a burst request (copy/paste).

Olivia (Ops): KB draft path: /docs/ops/quota-policy-draft-v1. I'll create a support macro.

Liam (AM): Agree. Also flag renewal-risk customers in CRM if they hit >90% for two consecutive weeks. I'll add a report.

Aisha (CS): Ok final asks:
- Kenji: confirm no other API breaking changes (yes/no)
- Olivia: INF ticket + admin flag + KB stub
- Liam: top-20 personalized outreach by Tue EOD
- Chen: example burst request snippet for KB
I'll collate and send the 72h comms template tomorrow.

Kenji (Product): No other breaking changes. Confirmed.

Olivia (Ops): INF-3421 opened. KB stub created. Banner task assigned to Tasha.

deploy-bot: INF-3421 status changed to "in progress" by olivia.ops

Aisha (CS): Thanks team :pray: Will schedule a 15-min sync Wed 16:00 UTC to review the email and banner screenshots.
